entries.en: I like that fountain. Very soothing.
You sure have to climb a lot of stairs to reach the Council. Think that's supposed to be symbolic of their importance?
I bet all these staircases aren't just for show. They make for good defensive positions if this place is ever attacked.
See how the trees and the fountain naturally blend with the arches of the Tower? They have done a masterful job of capturing the aesthetic values of the Protheans.
Not too many people have free access to the Tower. Even less get permission to meet the Council.
Not a lot of security here. Not that you can see, anyway. Ten to one there's a sniper tracking our every step.
We've tried to create organic environments back on the flotilla. But we lack the space for anything as grand as this.
